Generators of classes built by constructor functions

Source: R/zz_factory_classes.R
factory_classes.Rd

Some upstream classes only preset the arguments of their parent class, and manimR builds them with a function. They still have a class generator, a subclass of the upstream parent: MathTableClass inherits from TableClass, ReplacementTransformClass from TransformClass, and so on. MathTable() creates an object of MathTableClass, so inherits(x, "MathTable") is TRUE, a scene can subclass the generator, and set_default() changes the defaults of that class alone.

Value

R6 class generators. FooClass$new() takes the arguments of the constructor Foo() and returns the same object.

Examples

t <- MathTableClass
inherits(t$get_inherit(), "R6ClassGenerator")
#> [1] TRUE
